description.p: gchat is an independent desktop client for the DeepSeek API. Read streaming replies with formatted Markdown and highlighted code, and organize conversations with search and pins.
gchat 是独立的 DeepSeek API 桌面客户端。支持查看流式回复、 渲染 Markdown 和代码高亮，也可以搜索和置顶会话。
Conversations and drafts are saved locally. To send messages, you need your own DeepSeek API key. DeepSeek may charge for API usage.
会话和草稿保存在本地。发送消息需要你自己的 DeepSeek API 密钥。DeepSeek 可能会对 API 用量收费。
